description.value:
♋ Cancer is ascendant today. Your Cloth is awake and you have your Ascendant Boon for the whole day.

Any creature you reduce to 0 Hit Points dies, with no save.

Once per round as a free action, a creature within 30 feet at or below half Hit Points must attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC or take @Damage[8d6[void]] damage and be slowed 1.

You always know the direction of the nearest planar boundary.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Ascendant Constellation]. Applied and removed by the module's sky tracker; a GM can also drag it on by hand.
